items.scenario: You could manage the payment if you were allowed to split it over a few months, but not in one go. The supplier is asking for the whole amount. You have only recently started buying from them.
items.reply: We won't be able to pay the entire amount at once. Would you be comfortable if we split it into a few monthly payments?

items.scenario: You are waiting for your GST filing to be done before releasing payments this month. The supplier has followed up for the second time. They have been following up regularly for over a month now.
items.reply: I understand the delay has been frustrating. We're waiting for the GST filing to be completed before this month's payments can go out. We'll take this up immediately after that.

items.scenario: Your own customers owe you a lot of money and have not paid, so you cannot pay your suppliers either. The supplier is following up. The bill is about three weeks overdue.
items.reply: We're currently stuck because some of our customers haven't cleared their dues. That has pushed our supplier payments back as well. We're following up on the receivables and will clear this as soon as possible.

items.scenario: Business has been very slow for several months and you honestly do not have the cash right now. The supplier is asking for payment. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: We've had a difficult few months and cash is genuinely tight at the moment. I know the payment is pending, and I appreciate your understanding. We'll do our best to clear it as soon as the situation improves.

items.scenario: This is a small supplier and you have bigger payments to worry about this month. You are not planning to pay them yet. They have messaged you again. You have only recently started buying from them.
items.reply: We have a few larger payments lined up this month, so this one will have to wait for now. I'll keep it in the queue and update you when we can take it up.

items.scenario: The GST number printed on the bill is wrong, so your accounts team cannot process it. The supplier is asking why payment is delayed. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: There's an issue with the GST number on the invoice, and accounts won't be able to process it as it stands. Could you send a corrected copy?

items.scenario: Diwali is coming and your office will be shut for a week. You plan to clear pending bills after reopening. The supplier is asking. The bill is about three weeks overdue.
items.reply: We're closing for the Diwali holidays for a week, so the pending bills will be handled once we're back. We'll put yours through after reopening.

items.scenario: Your accounts team cannot find the purchase order number for this bill, so it is stuck. The supplier is asking about payment. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: Accounts can't find the PO number linked to this invoice, so it's currently stuck. If you have the PO number handy, please send it across and I'll get this checked.
